# Sketchfab environment assets

Place the downloaded model archives or extracted glTF/GLB files from the
`mrhardwired` Indian collection here. Include the original Sketchfab model
page URL and its displayed license for each model so the game can ship with
the required creator attribution.

Collection: https://sketchfab.com/mrhardwired/collections/indian-e14cfe67eb354f17a933c59f4a94b880

Relevant entries include the bamboo set/tree, Bamboo Bush, Jhai Ganesha Deva,
and any temple, bridge, or environment model you want included. The collection
contains works by many authors; a collection membership does not set a common
license for its models.
